verdict.rationale: Jules's only documented native issue-tracker hook is GitHub Issues: applying a "jules" label assigns the task to Jules. The Linear mention appears only in the API docs, as a developer building block for custom embeds, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: native connectors for Jira, Linear, ClickUp or Monday.com, any evidence that agents can create, update or close tickets directly, and independent corroboration of ticket management.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Use the "jules" label in an issue to assign a task directly in GitHub.
